neighbours.label: the fuller clause after a time skip ('Five years later, the same person may be doing well')
fire: Ten years later, the same man may be living well.
Five years later, the same family was doing fine.
Twenty years later, the same town is thriving again.
A decade later, the same girl was teaching there.
Three years later, the same firm may be growing fast.
Years later, the same boy was working abroad.
Six years later, the same patient is doing well.
Some years later, the same woman was living happily.
quiet: In this house, the same man may be living well.
In that village, the same family was doing fine.
On the coast, the same town is thriving again.
At that school, the same girl was teaching there.
In this market, the same firm may be growing fast.
In Spain, the same boy was working abroad.
In this ward, the same patient is doing well.
In that city, the same woman was living happily.

notes: The only probe that reached 0.3 was this frame. ' subsequent' 0.14 and the complementizer ' that' on the card are not covered.
